outputs.generate:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: WorldEngine house-family reference sheet, Style B, sheet 1
Primary request: A polished landscape contact sheet with six separate softly bevelled matte 3D architectural game house renders in a 3-column by 2-row grid on light sky-blue. Eye-level street view at 1.6 m, slight three-quarter front angle, no isometric top-down views. Each panel shows one entire house, roof fully visible, minimal sidewalk and low planting. Houses readable at phone size, simplified broad materials, rich saturated colours, coherent scale, gently rounded edges without melting rooflines. No photoreal textures. Strong warm afternoon sunlight, long soft cast shadows, deep blue-violet shade beneath eaves, bright bevel highlights, blue sky and atmospheric depth in each panel, readable porch shadows, restrained ambient occlusion.
Panels in reading order, labels exactly: "TUDOR", "COLONIAL", "PRAIRIE", "QUEEN ANNE", "CHICAGO BUNGALOW", "TWO-FLAT".
Tudor: steep asymmetric cross gables, brick lower wall, cream stucco upper gable with dark sparse half-timber bands, prominent tall brick chimney, grouped casement windows, small arched entry, no huge porch.
Colonial: symmetric two-storey red brick facade, central door with small classical portico and slender white columns, balanced sash windows with properly sized dark shutters, moderate side-gable roof.
Prairie: two-storey buff brick and warm cream stucco, low hipped roof and very broad thin overhangs, long grouped windows, broad square porch piers, strongly horizontal bands.
Queen Anne: asymmetrical two-storey sage and cream wood house, steep cross gables, one corner turret, wraparound porch with slim turned-looking posts simplified into coarse profiles, bays, warm contrasting trim.
Chicago bungalow: narrow one-and-half-storey brick house, low hipped roof with front dormer, grouped front bay windows, recessed small side entrance porch, raised basement and short stoop.
Two-flat: narrow two-storey red brick urban building, flat roof hidden by shallow parapet and simple cornice, two vertically stacked matching polygonal front bays, elevated shared side stoop with two entry doors in vestibule, small basement windows.
Constraints: architecture distinctions clear, no cars, no people, no ornate miniature clutter, no explanatory text besides six labels. Concept references, not scale drawings.
Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their rich colour, light, shade depth, smooth puff-cluster trees and simplified shapes. Do not copy their buildings or composition. No individual bricks, blades, photo textures, shingle repetition or miniature ornament. Roofs are broad uninterrupted colour planes.
